methodology.description: Nominal announcements are discounted by execution stage; deployed capital receives full weight. Scores are directional model outputs, not dollar-for-dollar monetary liquidity.

items.name: Japan U.S. investment framework
items.note: Framework includes up to $332B of critical energy infrastructure projects, including AP1000 and SMRs.

items.name: Korea strategic U.S. investment
items.note: Separate $150B shipbuilding investment is described as approved; this record tracks the additional $200B strategic investment MOU.

items.name: NVIDIA compute financing platforms
items.note: Third-party capital target; NVIDIA may backstop up to $125B. No full deployment timetable disclosed.

items.name: DOE TVA + Holtec SMR funding
items.note: Up to $800M federal cost-shared funding for early SMR deployments.

items.name: DOE domestic uranium enrichment awards
items.note: DOE describes $2.7B awards to strengthen domestic uranium enrichment capabilities.

items.name: 2026 Big Tech AI outlays
items.note: Combined 2026 Big Tech AI-related outlays are expected to surpass $730B; treated as active annual CAPEX pipeline rather than a single cash injection.
